cohort: A total of 1036 women (513 nulliparas and 523 multiparas) who were >=37 weeks pregnant with singleton cephalic fetuses, either by spontaneous onset or induction of labor, and gave birth between January 1 and December 31, 2019.
finding: Remifentanil-PCA consistently provided mild to moderate pain intensity reduction with effectiveness regardless of the stage of labor or parity, and no serious maternal or neonatal complications were observed.
mod_finding: Nulliparous women experienced significantly higher rates of cesarean sections and vacuum extractions compared to multiparous women.
